ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) safe-mode reboot chain — bcdedit safeboot + forced restart prior to encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin/Agenda-distinctive 'reboot into Safe Mode to disable EDR before encryption' chain — bcdedit toggles safeboot (often '/safeboot minimal' or 'network'), then shutdown.exe /r /f /t within minutes. Mirrors behaviour first surfaced by Trend Micro / Halcyon / Sophos for Qilin.B variants and the Synnovis NHS-linked intrusion.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.process_name) as proc_names values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND Processes.process="*safeboot*") OR (Processes.process_name="shutdown.exe" AND (Processes.process="*/r*" OR Processes.process="*-r*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | eventstats dc(process_name) as distinct_bins by dest _time | where distinct_bins>=2 | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(cmds) as cmds values(parents) as parents values(users) as users by dest | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 15m;
let SafeBoot = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ParentSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
let ForcedReboot = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("shutdown.exe","cmd.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("shutdown /r","shutdown -r","shutdown.exe /r")
         or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)shutdown(\.exe)?\s+[/-][rf]"
    | project ShutdownTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ShutdownCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
SafeBoot
| join kind=inner ForcedReboot on DeviceId
| where ShutdownTime between (SafeBootTime .. SafeBootTime + Window)
| project SafeBootTime, ShutdownTime,
          DelaySeconds = datetime_diff('second', ShutdownTime, SafeBootTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, SafeBootCmd, ShutdownCmd,
          Parent, ParentCmd, ParentSHA256
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 15m;
let SafeBoot = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeBootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              SafeBootCmd = CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let ForcedReboot = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\shutdown.exe"
    | where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s[/-][rf]\b"
    | project ShutdownTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ShutdownCmd = CommandLine;
SafeBoot
| join kind=inner ForcedReboot on Computer
| where ShutdownTime between (SafeBootTime .. SafeBootTime + Window)
| project SafeBootTime, ShutdownTime,
          DelaySeconds = datetime_diff('second', ShutdownTime, SafeBootTime),
          Computer, SubjectUserName, SafeBootCmd, ShutdownCmd, ParentProcessName
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Safe-Mode Boot Configuration Prior to Encryption
id: 4f3b9d8a-8e21-4d7b-9a4f-2e1b6a0c3f44
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit being used to configure the system to boot into Safe Mode, a hallmark of Qilin (Agenda) ransomware staging before encryption to evade EDR.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/j/qilin-ransomware.html
author: detection-engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot minimal'
      - 'safeboot network'
      - '/set safeboot'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: all of selection_* and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorised IT recovery / troubleshooting under change control
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.impact
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i CommandLine=/safeboot/i
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\shutdown\.exe$/i CommandLine=/\s[\/-][rf]/i}, field=aid, include=[ComputerName, CommandLine, ImageFileName], key=shutdown)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function={collect([CommandLine, shutdown.CommandLine, ImageFileName, shutdown.ImageFileName])})
ucs.rationale: Safe-Mode reboot is one of the few near-unique behavioural fingerprints of Qilin/Agenda (also seen in BlackCat/ALPHV and Snatch — all Russian-speaking criminal RaaS). The combination of bcdedit safeboot + forced /r reboot in the same short window has effectively no legitimate operational pattern outside of an attacker disabling EDR before encryption — Microsoft's MMPC and Halcyon reports on Qilin.

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) inhibit-recovery burst — shadow copy + backup catalog + boot recovery destruction
ucs.description: Hunts the pre-encryption 'scorched earth' sequence Qilin affiliates run from the ransomware binary or a SYSTEM-elevated cmd: vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy deletion, wbadmin catalog wipe, and bcdedit recoveryenabled=no / bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures, all within minutes. Targets the same chain documented by Trend Micro and Group-IB for Agenda payloads (Rust + Go variants).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmds values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadow*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*ignoreallfailures*")) ) by Processes.dest Processes.process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime dc(process_name) as distinct_techniques values(process_name) as techniques values(cmds) as cmds values(parents) as parents values(users) as users by dest _time | where distinct_techniques>=2 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Bucket = 15m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadow")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "catalog")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "ignoreallfailures" or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)recoveryenabled\s+no"))
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$" or InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel in ("High","System")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            TechniqueCount = dcount(FileName),
            Techniques = make_set(FileName),
            Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName),
            ParentCmds = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 5),
            ParentSHA256s = make_set(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
  by DeviceName, AccountName, TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, Bucket)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2     // 2 = vssadmin/wmic + bcdedit/wbadmin in same window — empirical Qilin signal
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Bucket = 15m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Proc = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where (Proc == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadow")
     or (Proc == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
     or (Proc == "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "catalog")
     or (Proc == "bcdedit.exe" and (CommandLine has "ignoreallfailures" or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)recoveryenabled\s+no"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" or TokenElevationType in ("%%1936","%%1937")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            TechniqueCount = dcount(Proc),
            Techniques = make_set(Proc),
            Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName)
  by Computer, SubjectUserName, TimeBucket = bin(TimeGenerated, Bucket)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ( (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* AND *shadow*)) OR (@Image:(*\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* AND *delete*)) OR (@Image:(*\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* AND *catalog*)) OR (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*ignoreallfailures* OR *"recoveryenabled no"*)) )
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i CommandLine=/delete.*shadow/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i CommandLine=/shadowcopy.*delete/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i CommandLine=/delete.*catalog/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no)/i)
| timebucket := formatTime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M", field=@timestamp, unit=15m)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, timebucket], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=tech_count), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])])
| tech_count >= 2
ucs.rationale: Individual LOLBins (vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit) fire on legit admin work — but Qilin/Agenda's Rust and Go binaries invoke at least two of these within ~30s as a deterministic pre-encryption sequence (documented by Trend Micro, Group-IB, and Sophos X-Ops on Synnovis-cluster cases). The dcount>=2-in-15m predicate is what separates a maintenance script from a Russian-speaking RaaS affiliate detonation;
